title: CHANGELOG missing: sign() algorithm selection changed (behavioral change)
description: sign() now selects the digest algorithm from the key's certificate rather than always using SHA-256. For P-384 and P-521 keys this changes the algorithm OID and hash in the SignedData — existing receivers that accepted SHA-256/P-384 SignedData may see different output. This is a behavioral change that must be in the CHANGELOG under 'Changed' or 'Fixed'. Also: smime-tree/CLAUDE.md Processor API section should reflect that sign() now respects preferred_digest_algorithm().
